title: Final Answer for c_v
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the specific heat c_v for T to infinity as Nk.

title: Final Exponents
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the exponents alpha and gamma as both equal to 1.

title: Thermal Equilibrium Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of thermal equilibrium and its implications on energy calculations.

title: Quantum Mechanical Treatment
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply quantum mechanics principles correctly in the derivation of U.

title: Limit Behavior Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should analyze the limit behaviors of U as T approaches 0 and infinity appropriately.

title: Summation Techniques
description: Optional Criteria: The student may use appropriate summation techniques for large N to simplify calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations to avoid errors.

title: Common Errors in Limits
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes in evaluating limits, particularly in the exponential terms.
